sections.title: Peychaud's Cocktail Bitters
sections.content_original: 100 years ago in New Orleans, the cradle of civilized drinking, Peychaud's Cocktail Bitters was born. From that time till 1918, Peychaud's could be found on every bar of prominence throughout the world. It was the flavor which Peychaud's imparted that helped make many cocktails famous. Peychaud's could not be made during prohibition. It is a cocktail bitters and was against the law. Now Peychaud's is back. Use it with John Held Jr.'s recipes and you will become famous for your cocktails. Don't ask for Bitters if you want to make cocktails. Ask for the original Peychaud's. Bottled in small, medium, large and bar sizes. Peychaud's was awarded gold medals in Germany 1869, New Orleans 1884, 1885, Atlanta 1895, St. Louis 1904, Portland 1905, Jamestown 1907. Manufactured and Distributed exclusively by A. M. & J. Solari, Ltd., New Orleans. American Diploma of Honor exhibited Hamburg 1869. 70 Proof. Contents 8 Fl. Ozs.
sections.content_es: Hace 100 años, en Nueva Orleans, cuna del beber civilizado, nacieron los Amargos para Cóctel Peychaud's. Desde esa época hasta 1918, Peychaud's se podía encontrar en todos los bares de prestigio del mundo. Fue el sabor que Peychaud's aportaba lo que ayudó a hacer famosos a muchos cócteles. Peychaud's no se pudo elaborar durante la Prohibición; al ser un amargo para coctelería, estaba prohibido por la ley. Ahora Peychaud's ha regresado. Úselo con las recetas de John Held Jr. y se hará famoso por sus cócteles. No pida 'Bitters' si quiere preparar cócteles. Pida el Peychaud's original. Embotellado en tamaños pequeño, mediano, grande y de bar. Peychaud's recibió medallas de oro en Alemania 1869, Nueva Orleans 1884 y 1885, Atlanta 1895, San Luis 1904, Portland 1905 y Jamestown 1907. Fabricado y distribuido exclusivamente por A. M. & J. Solari, Ltd., Nueva Orleans. Diploma de Honor Americano exhibido en Hamburgo 1869. 70 Proof. Contenido 8 onzas líquidas.

sections.title: When Absinthe Is Called For Use Greenopal
sections.title_es: Cuando se pida Absenta, use Greenopal
sections.content_original: When Absinthe Is Called For Use Greenopal (Registered U. S. Patent Office 1913). Greenopal is a distilled product made in accordance with the formula for Absinthe with one exception. Greenopal contains no wormwood. The United States Government prohibits the importation, manufacture or sale of Absinthe containing wormwood. Wormwood is a poison and should not be taken into the human system. Greenopal has all the bouquet, flavor and exhilarating effects of Absinthe—it only lacks the harmful after-effects. Greenopal is distilled by the same famous old house that makes Peychaud's Bitters. Ask for it wherever Peychaud's Bitters is sold. Use it whenever Absinthe is called for. A. M. & J. Solari, Ltd., New Orleans.
sections.content_es: Cuando se pida Absenta, use Greenopal (Registrado en la Oficina de Patentes de EE. UU. 1913). Greenopal es un producto destilado elaborado según la fórmula de la Absenta con una excepción: Greenopal no contiene ajenjo. El Gobierno de los Estados Unidos prohíbe la importación, fabricación o venta de Absenta que contenga ajenjo. El ajenjo es un veneno y no debería ingerirse en el organismo humano. Greenopal posee todo el bouquet, el sabor y los efectos estimulantes de la Absenta; solo le faltan los efectos secundarios nocivos. Greenopal es destilado por la misma antigua y famosa casa que elabora Peychaud's Bitters. Pídalo dondequiera que se venda Peychaud's Bitters. Úselo siempre que se requiera Absenta. A. M. & J. Solari, Ltd., Nueva Orleans.

sections.title: Pink Shimmy (Name Copyrighted by Solari's, New Orleans)
sections.title_es: Pink Shimmy (Nombre registrado por Solari's, Nueva Orleans)
sections.content_original: Pink Shimmy Cocktail. Pink Shimmy is a cocktail originated in New Orleans, the birthplace of civilized drinking. Even during prohibition Pink Shimmy was imitated throughout the world. It is owned exclusively by Solari's and is sold by stores handling Peychaud's Bitters.
sections.content_es: Cóctel Pink Shimmy. Pink Shimmy es un cóctel originario de Nueva Orleans, la cuna del beber civilizado. Incluso durante la Prohibición, Pink Shimmy fue imitado por todo el mundo. Pertenece en exclusiva a Solari's y se vende en los establecimientos que distribuyen Peychaud's Bitters.

recipes.name_es: Cóctel de Whiskey de Nueva Orleans

ingredients.item_original: simple syrup (or one lump of sugar dissolved in a teaspoonful of water)
ingredients.item_es: jarabe simple (o un terrón de azúcar disuelto en una cucharadita de agua)

recipes.method_original: First take a mixing glass and put into it a teaspoonful of simple syrup, or one lump of sugar dissolved in a teaspoonful of water. Add two dashes Peychaud's Bitters, one jigger of Whiskey (preferably Rye), one cube of ice. Stir well. Use second glass with two dashes Greenopal. Strain contents of first glass into second glass. Squeeze small piece of lemon peel over cocktail, then serve.
recipes.method_es: Primero tome un vaso mezclador y ponga en él una cucharadita de jarabe simple, o un terrón de azúcar disuelto en una cucharadita de agua. Agregue dos golpes de Amargos Peychaud's, un jigger de whiskey (preferiblemente Rye) y un cubo de hielo. Remueva bien. Use un segundo vaso con dos golpes de Greenopal. Cuele el contenido del primer vaso en el segundo. Exprima un pequeño trozo de cáscara de limón sobre el cóctel y sirva.
recipes.glassware: vaso de cóctel (segundo vaso enjuagado con Greenopal)
recipes.raw_text:
NEW ORLEANS WHISKEY COCKTAIL

First take a mixing glass and put into it a teaspoonful of simple syrup, or one lump of sugar dissolved in a teaspoonful of water. Add two dashes Peychaud's Bitters, one jigger of Whiskey (preferably Rye), one cube of ice. Stir well. Use second glass with two dashes Greenopal. Strain contents of first glass into second glass. Squeeze small piece of lemon peel over cocktail, then serve.

recipes.method_original: The real art in making a Gin Fizz is in proper shaking. Don't just shake a few times and think you have done the job, because it is only started. You need plenty of ice and you should shake until the contents of the Fizz have become so creamy that you won't be able to hear the ice tinkle against the sides of the shaker. Don't forget that, because your Gin Fizz won't be a real New Orleans concoction unless you follow these directions. Fill glass with ice, shake well and strain into thin glass. These are the proportions for one Fizz.
recipes.method_es: El verdadero arte de un Gin Fizz está en agitarlo correctamente. No basta con agitar unas pocas veces y pensar que está listo, porque eso es apenas el comienzo. Necesita abundante hielo y debe agitar hasta que el contenido del Fizz quede tan cremoso que no se oiga el hielo tintinear contra las paredes de la coctelera. No lo olvide, porque su Gin Fizz no será una verdadera creación de Nueva Orleans si no sigue estas indicaciones. Llene el vaso con hielo, agite bien y cuele en un vaso fino. Estas son las proporciones para un Fizz.
recipes.raw_text:
NEW ORLEANS GIN FIZZ

The real art in making a Gin Fizz is in proper shaking. Don't just shake a few times and think you have done the job, because it is only started. You need plenty of ice and you should shake until the contents of the Fizz have become so creamy that you won't be able to hear the ice tinkle against the sides of the shaker. Don't forget that, because your Gin Fizz won't be a real New Orleans concoction unless you follow these directions.

One tablespoonful of granulated sugar, juice of half a lemon, two dashes Orange Flower Water, white of one Egg, jigger of Dry Gin, and about two ounces of Cream.

Fill glass with ice, shake well and strain into thin glass. These are the proportions for one Fizz.

recipes.method_original: Into a bowl put a quantity of the tender leaves of fresh mint. Cover these leaves with powdered sugar. Add a few drops of water to dissolve the sugar and then crush with wooden pestle. Transfer crushed mint leaves and sugar to glass. Then fill glass with finely shaved ice. Now pour in fine old Bourbon or Rye, as you prefer. Place sprig of fresh mint at edge of glass. Let stand in ice box until frosted. Use short straw so that drinker's nose is buried in the mint.
recipes.method_es: En un cuenco coloque una cantidad de hojas tiernas de menta fresca. Cubra esas hojas con azúcar glas. Añada unas gotas de agua para disolver el azúcar y maje con un mortero de madera. Pase las hojas de menta majadas con el azúcar al vaso. Luego llene el vaso con hielo finamente raspado. Vierta ahora Bourbon o Rye añejo, según prefiera. Coloque una ramita de menta fresca en el borde del vaso. Déjelo en la nevera hasta que se escarche. Use una pajita corta para que la nariz del bebedor quede hundida en la menta.

1 Ounce Lemon Juice.
2 Ounces Dry Gin.
Shake well in ice and add charged water to fill glass.

recipes.method_original: Fill glass with fine ice. Do not shake. Stir thoroughly with spoon, strain into long stem glass. We recommend the use of Fernandez White Label Spanish Ojen or Solari's Ojen.
recipes.method_es: Llene el vaso con hielo fino. No agite. Remueva a fondo con cuchara, cuele en una copa larga con pie. Recomendamos usar Ojen español Fernandez Etiqueta Blanca o el Ojen de Solari's.
recipes.raw_text:
PINK SHIMMY (The Ojen Cocktail)
2 Ounces Ojen.
2 or 3 Dashes Peychaud's Bitters, until colored pink.
Fill glass with fine ice.
Do not shake. Stir thoroughly with spoon, strain into long stem glass.
We recommend the use of Fernandez White Label Spanish Ojen or Solari's Ojen.
AND OUT OF THIS COMES PEACE, HAPPINESS AND JOY

ingredients.notes: media dentro del vaso, media colgando del borde

recipes.method_original: Peel 1 Lemon whole. Place one-half of lemon peel in glass and hang the other half over edge. Fill glass with ice and Ginger Ale.
recipes.method_es: Pele 1 limón en una sola tira. Coloque la mitad de la cáscara dentro del vaso y deje la otra mitad colgando del borde. Llene el vaso con hielo y ginger ale.
recipes.raw_text:
HORSE'S NECK
Peel 1 Lemon whole. Place one-half of lemon peel in glass and hang the other half over edge.
1 Jigger Whiskey.
2 Dashes Peychaud's Bitters.
Fill glass with ice and Ginger-Ale.
GIDUP, NAPOLEON

recipes.method_original: Add ice and fill glass with charged water.
recipes.method_es: Añada hielo y llene el vaso con agua carbonatada.
recipes.raw_text:
PEYCHAUD'S TOM COLLINS
1 Teaspoon Sugar.
1 Ounce Lemon Juice.
2 Ounces Dry Gin.
Dash of Peychaud's Bitters.
Add ice and fill glass with charged water.

recipes.method_original: Shake vigorously and strain. Go places—do things, and let your conscience be your guide.
recipes.method_es: Agite vigorosamente y cuele. Vaya a sitios, haga cosas y deje que su conciencia le guíe.
recipes.raw_text:
PEYCHAUD'S CLOVER CLUB
Juice of 1/2 Lemon.
1/2 Spoon of Sugar.
1/2 Pony Grenadine.
1/4 Pony of White of Egg.
1 Full portion of Gin.
Dash of Peychaud's Bitters.
Shake vigorously and strain. Go places—do things, and let your conscience be your guide.

recipes.method_original: Shake well with ice, serve in cocktail glass with Cherry.
recipes.method_es: Agite bien con hielo, sirva en copa de cóctel con una cereza.
recipes.raw_text:
BLUE MOON
Creme Yvette.
Dry Gin.
Dashes Peychaud's Bitters.
Shake well with ice, serve in cocktail glass with Cherry.
SIGNAL FOR YOUR TURNS
